clips.title: The story
paras: The Ancient Moonstone Seal holds Asterion captive in the ruins of Bashal'Aran. Forged by the Highborne long before the Sundering, it binds his spirit with arcane magic.

The Ancient Moonstone Seal binds Asterion's soul to the pillars of Bashal'Aran. His former master, the Highborne sorcerer Athrikus Narassin, forged it as an unbreakable anchor while the Well of Eternity still stood and Queen Azshara reigned. More than ten millennia later, Asterion remains a spirit bound by its magic. No strength or spell he commands can break the ward.
